## Why Local Cursor (Not Only CoderPad)

CoderPad’s AI Assist context is limited to about **200k tokens**. Heavy assessment load (screenshots, full tree, multi-file edits, write-up) burns that budget.

**Decision:** use CoderPad as the official runtime / paste target; do heavy editing in **local Cursor** with **[cursor-prime](https://github.com/xnoahwang/cursor-prime)** already installed.

**Not used:** a separate in-pad rule pack that duplicates cursor-prime. This project ships **code + `submission/` + inline comments**; full rules live in the cursor-prime repo.

### Cursor-Prime Highlights (What Mattered Here)

Fill the right column for *this* assessment (delete unused rows if truly N/A — prefer filling them).

| Capability | How it showed up in this assessment |
|------------|-------------------------------------|
| **Plan Gate** | Plan → wait for **`GO`** → then edit |
| **Surgical changes** | Only files on the pre-flight / sync list |
| **Hard verify** | (e.g. test/build command + result) |
| **MVP → waves** | v1 … ; later waves … |
| **Maintainability** | File headers + why-comments; Handover / Reflection / Appendix |
| **Paste-back** | **Changed files only** + What We Changed |
| **Judgment trail** | Iteration Log, abandoned approaches, security/perf considered vs shipped |

Deep rule text and slash commands stay on the machine — not copied into the pad.

## Files to Sync to CoderPad

Paths relative to project root. **Only files you changed** (plus updated `submission/`). Do **not** re-upload untouched pad files — reviewers get whole-file replaces, so keep the set small and describe edits below.

Update whenever the pre-flight / Delta list changes.

### Required

Format: `- [ ] \`path\` — **what changed** (function/behavior); why`

- [ ] `path` — **what changed**; why
- [ ] `submission/1. Handover.md` — What We Changed / run notes updated
- [ ] `submission/2. Reflection.md` — Iteration Log / judgment updated
- [ ] `submission/3. Appendix.md` — this checklist updated

### Optional

- [ ] `path` — **what changed**; why

### Unchanged (Do Not Replace)

- (list pad files you deliberately left alone)

### Do Not Upload

- `meta-instruction.md` (local conductor playbook — keep only on disk)
- `node_modules/`, build artifacts, local cursor-prime clones, session-only `progress.md` (optional)

## Workflow / How This Was Done

Local conductor: `meta-instruction.md` (not uploaded). Chat steps in Chinese; one step at a time.

### Phase A — Capture tree

1. Screenshot CoderPad file tree only; share into local Cursor.

### Phase B — Empty tree + paste

2. Recreate empty tree; human pastes pad sources file-by-file.

### Phase C — Runnable local

3. Assignment install/deps; smoke or starter tests green (or blocker noted).

### Phase D — Requirements → plan → GO

4. Confirm requirements checklist; Plan Gate → **`GO`** → implement with comments + growing `submission/`.

### Phase E — Review + polish

5. Human review/fixes; refresh Handover / Reflection (incl. abandoned approaches) / Appendix sync list.

### Phase F — Return to pad

6. Paste/replace using **Files to Sync** (exclude `meta-instruction.md`); run official pad tests.
